seo_desc: Dusty rose maternity photoshoot gown with a ruffled V-neck, flowing tulle skirt, ruffle tiers and a long train. US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: a dusty rose gown with a ruffle-trimmed V-neck, a high waist above the bump, and a long flowing tulle skirt that drops into tiers of ruffles and a train that fans out when you twirl.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 7 days, so please allow about 19-23 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
sleeveless ruffle-trimmed V-neck bodice, high waist above the bump, a flowing tulle skirt that falls into tiers of gathered ruffles, and a long sweeping train.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
Hand wash cold or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam on low to remove creases.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Choose by your bust today; the high waist and flowing skirt leave room for the bump. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.

image_prompt:
DRESS LIKE MOMMY — RELIABLE PHOTOSHOOT SYSTEM (automated run)

The attached images are the exact reference for ONE Shopify listing: a maternity photoshoot gown, "Ruffle V-Neck Tiered Tulle Train Maternity Photoshoot Gown", in DUSTY ROSE (a muted dusty rose pink).
The gown (ref1 full length, ref2 and ref3 the same gown): a dusty rose maternity gown with a sleeveless wrap-style V-neck bodice trimmed with small ruffles at the neckline and shoulders, a high waist seam above the bump, a long flowing sheer tulle skirt that falls into three gathered ruffle tiers at the hem, and a very long train. The ruffles are soft, gathered tulle in the same dusty rose; the upper skirt is smooth sheer tulle and the ruffled tiers start below the hips.

Generate FOUR separate images in this order and save each into the current working directory with exactly these names:
- image1.png — IMAGE 1, MAIN HERO: a visibly pregnant woman (about 7 months) standing in a bright, softly lit photo studio with a plain light backdrop, wearing this gown, one hand on her bump, the other lifting the skirt so the ruffled tiers and the train show; full length, front-facing, gown in sharp focus.
- image3.png — IMAGE 3, BEST OCCASION: the same woman at an outdoor maternity photoshoot in a meadow at golden hour, the tulle skirt and train moving in the breeze; full length.
- image5.png — IMAGE 5, PRODUCT-ONLY: no people. The gown displayed on a white dress form (mannequin) in a bright studio, the train spread around the base, showing the ruffled V-neck, the high waist and the ruffle tiers clearly.
- image6.png — IMAGE 6, ALTERNATE LIFESTYLE: the same pregnant woman on a beach at sunset with her partner (a man in a plain white shirt and beige trousers) standing behind her with his hands on her bump; she wears the gown; three-quarter length.
Do not ask me anything; continue until all four files are saved. Keep the same woman across images 1, 3 and 6.

Each output: one single vertical 9:16 photo, no collage, no borders, no text, no watermark. Crop minimally to 9:16 if needed.
PRODUCT LOCK: dusty rose colour, sleeveless ruffle-trimmed V-neck bodice, high waist, flowing tulle skirt falling into three ruffle tiers with a long train. No belt, no sequins. No logos, no letters, no extra embellishment.
MODEL STYLE: a natural-looking European woman, fair to light-medium skin, warm smile, tasteful and elegant; a different woman from the reference photos.
STRICT QUALITY CHECK before saving: reject and regenerate if the gown design or colour changed, the ruffle tiers or train are missing, she does not look pregnant, extra text appears, it is a collage, not 9:16, or it looks fake.
When all four files are saved, reply with one line per file: name, width x height.
